segments.name: Global RIM Business
segments.description: Stores physical records and provides information management, digital solutions, secure shredding, media and archive, and consumer storage services to customers in many countries.
segments.evidence: The Global Records and Information Management ("Global RIM") Business segment includes several distinct offerings.

segments.name: Global Data Center Business
segments.description: Provides enterprise-class data center facilities and hyperscale-ready capacity that protect mission-critical assets and keep customers' IT infrastructure operating reliably.
segments.evidence: The Global Data Center Business segment provides enterprise-class data center facilities and hyperscale-ready capacity to protect mission-critical assets and ensure the continued operation of our customers' IT infrastructure with secure, reliable and flexible data center options.

segments.name: Corporate and Other
segments.description: Runs the asset lifecycle management and fine arts businesses and carries corporate items such as executive, finance, human resources and IT costs.
segments.evidence: Corporate and Other consists primarily of our ALM and Fine Arts businesses and other corporate items ("Corporate and Other").

revenueModel.text: Customers pay storage rental and service fees, largely recurring under multi-year agreements, for records storage, digital solutions, data center capacity and asset lifecycle management.
revenueModel.evidence: Our contracted storage rental agreements in our Records Management business generally range from one to five years in length.
